top.why: INVERSION on USDCx: supply Zest V2 1.42% vs borrow Granite 1.21%
top.text:
USDCx is inverted across venues.

Supplying at Zest V2 pays 1.42%. Borrowing the same asset at Granite costs 1.21%.

+21 bps, before fees, gas and liquidation risk.

sbor.xyz
